easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Displace.
description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Displace, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Displace, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
